grammar.purpose: Say what someone does or what something is like
grammar.explanation: A predicate can be a verb or verb phrase: 朋友们进来; 我学习汉语. It can also be an adjective phrase: 邻居很热情; 杯子坏了. Match the subject to the action or property. 是 is not required before an ordinary adjective predicate. A word’s category is not a command to use it in every possible predicate position.

examples.zh: 朋友们进来，我们一起吃面条儿。
examples.py: péng you men jìn lái , wǒ men yì qǐ chī miàn tiáor .
examples.en: Our friends come in; we have noodles together.

examples.py: lín jū hěn rè qíng , bēi zi huài le .
examples.en: The neighbours are welcoming; the cup is broken.

commonMistakes.why: A neutral adjective description does not need 是.

grammar.purpose: Report a fact without turning it into a question
grammar.explanation: A statement gives information: 我住在这里; 我不是工人. It normally ends with a full stop, not a question particle 吗. Use 不 for present negation of 是 or a general habit, and 没 for an action that did not happen. A statement can include 了 or an appropriate adverb. Do not infer that someone completed a course merely because they say 我学习汉语.

examples.zh: 我住在这里，我还在学习汉语。
examples.py: wǒ zhù zài zhè lǐ , wǒ hái zài xué xí hàn yǔ .
examples.en: I live here; I am still learning Mandarin.

examples.zh: 我不是工人，昨天没去学校。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì gōng rén , zuó tiān méi qù xué xiào .
examples.en: I am not a worker; I did not go to school yesterday.

commonMistakes.why: Remove 吗 when stating where you live.

grammar.pattern: identity / category · defining characteristic · presence at a place
grammar.purpose: Use 是 with the intended relation
grammar.explanation: Identity/category: 我的邻居是工人. A characteristic can use a noun phrase: 她是一个热情的人; this differs from the direct adjective predicate 她很热情. A place + 是 + noun phrase describes what occupies it: 门外是一棵树; 前边是学校. Compare 门外有一棵树, which introduces something present. These location descriptions require a clear scene, not a blanket substitution of 是 for every 有.

lines.zh: 你在这里住一个月了，还在学习汉语吗？
lines.py: nǐ zài zhè lǐ zhù yī gè yuè le , hái zài xué xí hàn yǔ ma ?
lines.en: You have lived here for a month. Are you still studying Mandarin?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还在学习。朋友们常常来，我们一起读书。
lines.py: hái zài xué xí . péng you men cháng cháng lái , wǒ men yì qǐ dú shū .
lines.en: I still am. My friends often visit; we read together.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 门开着，我可以进来吗？
lines.py: mén kāi zhe , wǒ kě yǐ jìn lái ma ?
lines.en: The door is open. May I come in?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 请进，请坐！先喝点水。
lines.py: qǐng jìn , qǐng zuò ! xiān hē diǎn shuǐ .
lines.en: Please come in and sit down! Have a little water first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 门外的小孩儿是谁？他在树下玩。
lines.py: mén wài de xiǎo háir shì shéi ? tā zài shù xià wán .
lines.en: Who is the young child outside? He is playing under the tree.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是邻居的儿子。那个小孩儿常和小朋友一起玩。
lines.py: shì lín jū de ér zi . nà gè xiǎo háir cháng hé xiǎo péng yǒu yì qǐ wán .
lines.en: He is my neighbour’s son. That young child often plays with other children.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你的邻居是工人吗？
lines.py: nǐ de lín jū shì gōng rén ma ?
lines.en: Is your neighbour a worker?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是，她很热情，也常照顾孩子。我们今天吃面条儿。
lines.py: shì , tā hěn rè qíng , yě cháng zhào gù hái zi . wǒ men jīn tiān chī miàn tiáor .
lines.en: Yes, she is welcoming and often looks after the children. We are having noodles today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 桌子上的两个杯子可以用吗？
lines.py: zhuō zi shàng de liǎng gè bēi zi kě yǐ yòng ma ?
lines.en: Can we use the two cups on the table?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这个坏了，别用。那个是好的，你坐下喝水吧。
lines.py: zhè gè huài le , bié yòng . nà gè shì hǎo de , nǐ zuò xià hē shuǐ ba .
lines.en: This one is broken; do not use it. That one is fine. Sit down and have water.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 大家从门外进去吃饭，最后洗杯子，对吗？
lines.py: dà jiā cóng mén wài jìn qù chī fàn , zuì hòu xǐ bēi zi , duì ma ?
lines.en: Everyone goes inside to eat, then washes the cups at the end, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。这本书是你的，我明天还给你。
lines.py: duì . zhè běn shū shì nǐ de , wǒ míng tiān huán gěi nǐ .
lines.en: Right. This book is yours; I will return it tomorrow.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在这里住一个月了，还在学习汉语。
lines.py: wǒ zài zhè lǐ zhù yī gè yuè le , hái zài xué xí hàn yǔ .
lines.en: I have lived here for a month and am still learning Mandarin.

lines.zh: 朋友们常来，我请他们进来，请坐，喝点水。
lines.py: péng you men cháng lái , wǒ qǐng tā men jìn lái , qǐng zuò , hē diǎn shuǐ .
lines.en: My friends often visit. I invite them in, ask them to sit and offer a little water.

lines.zh: 门外是一棵树，前边是学校。我的邻居是工人。
lines.py: mén wài shì yī kē shù , qián biān shì xué xiào . wǒ de lín jū shì gōng rén .
lines.en: Outside the door is a tree and ahead is the school. My neighbour is a worker.

lines.zh: 她很热情，她的儿子是个小孩儿，常在树下玩。
lines.py: tā hěn rè qíng , tā de ér zi shì gè xiǎo háir , cháng zài shù xià wán .
lines.en: She is welcoming. Her son is a young child who often plays under the tree.

lines.zh: 今天门开着，大家从门外进去吃面条儿。
lines.py: jīn tiān mén kāi zhe , dà jiā cóng mén wài jìn qù chī miàn tiáor .
lines.en: Today the door is open; everyone goes inside to have noodles.

lines.zh: 我坐下读日记，朋友们坐在桌子旁边。
lines.py: wǒ zuò xià dú rì jì , péng you men zuò zài zhuō zi páng biān .
lines.en: I sit down to read my diary; my friends sit beside the table.

lines.zh: 桌子上有两个杯子，一个坏了，另一个可以用。
lines.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng gè bēi zi , yī gè huài le , lìng yī gè kě yǐ yòng .
lines.en: There are two cups on the table; one is broken and the other can be used.

lines.zh: 最后我们一起收桌子。朋友借我一本书，我明天还给她。我还想学新的词。
lines.py: zuì hòu wǒ men yì qǐ shōu zhuō zi . péng you jiè wǒ yī běn shū , wǒ míng tiān huán gěi tā . wǒ hái xiǎng xué xīn de cí .
lines.en: At the end we clear the table together. A friend lent me a book; I will return it tomorrow. I still want to learn new words.
